# The first notes of sub-question 2 hold a claim with no source. The check names the file, the item goes back to the research step for it, and the next check passes.
# Only the notes of sub-question 2 are researched again, and the research agent gets the line of the check.
isolate

exec git init -q -b main origin
exec git -C origin add readme.txt
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m start

example research/workflow.star
example research/project.star config/projects/research.star
example research/prompts/scope.md
example research/prompts/research.md
example research/prompts/review.md
example research/prompts/revise.md
example research/prompts/conclude.md
example research/tools/check.sh
example research/tools/report.sh
replace config/projects/research.star '~/work/your-repo' $WORK/origin
fakeclaude
serve

env RESEARCH_TOOLS=$WORK/research/tools
env RESEARCH_OUT=$WORK/out

exec obeereal item add research weigh-ab --title 'Compare A and B' --body-file body.txt

exec obeereal run weigh-ab research --workflow research/workflow.star
stdout 'item weigh-ab finished'

exec obeereal status
stdout 'weigh-ab-r1\tdone'

cmp calls.log expected-calls.log
cmp found.log expected-found.log

# The notes that the second research step wrote are in the report.
grep '^- Claim 2\. ' out/weigh-ab.md
! grep 'has no source' out/weigh-ab.md
